in_arabic.name: Qamayr
in_arabic.long_meaning: Qamayr هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'qamr' which means grape, this name symbolizes the sweetness and abundance of life.
